name: @novelai-image-mcp/server
description: MCP server exposing NovelAI image generation as tools for AI agents

scripts.lint: uv run ruff check src tests
scripts.lint:fix: uv run ruff check --fix src tests
scripts.format: uv run ruff format src tests
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check src tests
scripts.serve:http: MCP_TRANSPORT=http uv run python -m novelai_image_mcp serve
scripts.dev: uv run fastmcp dev inspector mcp_server.py
